newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Steel to acquire Amalco Metals.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Steel to acquire Amalco Metals.

text.p: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co on Thursday said it has struck a deal to acquire all the outstanding shares of Amalco Metals Inc, a privately-held metals service center Union City, Calif.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed. It is expected to be completed in 30 days, Reliance said in a statement.
Amalco Metals' sales for its fiscal year ended April 30, 1996, were approximately $31 million.
Amalco Metals will eventually be merged with Reliance's Santa Clara, Calif. metals service center. Amalco specializes in precision cut aluminum plate and sheet products.
